verdict.rationale: Circle documents its own fiat-to-stablecoin conversion: qualified businesses can use a Circle Mint account to convert USD to and from USDC, and a community comment corroborates minting and redemption at par. Related treasury tools exist too, including StableFX trade quotes, a chain-abstracted Gateway balance and CPN fiat payouts. However, the pack shows no Mint API or dashboard workflow for moving or rebalancing between fiat and stablecoin balances, and nothing that documents the flow end to end. Missing for 10: documented Mint API/dashboard endpoints for fiat↔USDC deposits, redemptions and internal transfers; an end-to-end rebalancing guide; hands-on corroboration of the treasury workflow.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can move value between fiat and stablecoin balances on the platform — internal transfers and rebalancing through the API or dashboard, documented end to end

citations.quote: Qualified businesses can apply for a Circle Mint account to readily convert USD to and from USDC at no additional cost.
Creates a quote for a trade between two currencies.
Circle Gateway allows you to create a chain-abstracted USDC, EURC, or cirBTC balance and transfer it instantly to any supported destination chain.
Circle mints and redeems USDC at par, without charging a spread like 100bps.
